# `tfctl get`

The `tfctl get` command fetches a single resource by ID or lists resources by type.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl get RESOURCE_OR_ID [ID] [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl get` command fetches a single resource by ID or lists resources by type. This is a convenience command that provides an easier way to retrieve resources compared to using `tfctl api` directly.

When given a resource type name (e.g., `workspaces`), the command lists all resources of that type. When given an ID (e.g., `ws-abc123`), it fetches the single resource. A two-argument form allows specifying both type and ID: `get workspace ws-abc123`.

## Arguments

- `RESOURCE_OR_ID` - (Required) Resource type name or resource ID.
- `ID` - (Optional) Resource ID (when first argument is the resource type).

## Available options

The `tfctl get` command supports the following options.

| Option | Description | Default | Required |
|--------|-------------|---------|----------|
| `--all` | Paginate through all results. Fetches all pages of results automatically. | `false` | No |
| `-o, --organization=NAME` | Organization name. | Auto-resolved from profile or Terraform cloud config | No |
| `-n, --page-number=NUMBER` | Page number to fetch (1-indexed). Ignored if `--all` is set. | `1` | No |
| `-s, --page-size=NUMBER` | Number of results per page. Ignored if `--all` is set. | Varies by resource | No |

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Pagination

When listing multiple resources, the command supports flexible pagination. By default, returns a single page of results, with the default page size is determined by the API. Use `--page-size` to control how many records per page, and `--page-number` to fetch a specific page.

You can also use the `--all` flag to automatically fetch all pages. When using `--all`, the command fetches the first page, follows pagination links in the response, and continues until all pages are fetched.

## Examples

### List all workspaces in the active organization

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspaces
```

### Fetch a single workspace by ID

```shell-session
$ tfctl get ws-abc123
```

### Fetch a workspace by type and ID

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspace ws-abc123
```

### List all workspaces (paginate through all pages)

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspaces --all
```

### List workspaces with custom pagination

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspaces --page-size 50 --page-number 2
```

### List workspaces in a specific organization

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspaces -o my-org
```
